notes: This phase replaces the failed v1 vertical label-packing idea with screen-space horizontal placement only; the historical time anchor never moves.
When the current viewport cannot fit every eligible label without collision, excess labels are explicitly deferred until additional spatial/time zoom creates enough pixels.
No notability or editorial importance score decides which ordinary labels appear; deterministic geometry does. User-selected/searched Persons are the only priority override.
Connectors, when needed, are horizontal because the label and historical anchor share the exact same Y coordinate.
The production v1 renderer and its previous packing code remain untouched until the later v2 cutover.
